name: line-comment
description: Review comments on lines of any file, kept outside the file. Zed writes them through the line-comment language server; /line-comment:act reads the store and does the work, /line-comment:write places comments, /line-comment:unresolved reports what is still open, /line-comment:prune throws comments away, /line-comment:distill turns the habits act saved into review rules.
